# tarja

> Brazilian personal identifiers in free Portuguese text, with check-digit validation. Apache 2.0 Python
> library, no runtime dependency. Detects 17 identifier types across three tiers: N1 strong check digit
> (11 types), N2 format only (3), N3 requires a nearby context word (3).

Install with `pip install tarja`. The Presidio plugin is `pip install tarja-presidio`.

Two things to know before quoting any number from this project:

- **Benchmark figures are reported per match mode.** `exact`, `partial` and `untyped` give different F1 on
  the same data, and the gap reaches 27% on the OCR-noise subset (0.2099 exact against 0.26621 partial). A
  figure quoted without naming its mode is not a figure.
- **A wrong check digit means "not a valid identifier", not "not personal data".** It is as often a typo in
  a real one. On a last gate before text leaves a perimeter, pass `report_invalid=True` and decide yourself.
  Version 0.9.0 closed five defects where a threshold or a wrong check digit let data through in silence.

- [Presidio, in English](https://macmaia.github.io/tarja/presidio.html): why Presidio finds no CPF out of the box, and the two ways out
- [Presidio, em portugues](https://macmaia.github.io/tarja/presidio-em-portugues.html)
- [Official source per entity](https://macmaia.github.io/tarja/SOURCES.html): the normative document behind each validator, and whether it was read
